title: Normalized first completed residue ideal equals extended discrete residue ideal
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a Noetherian scheme X, extend the kernel of the first completed constant residue projection along the small-site image of completedSectionIso [def-sfb-integral-models-completed-section-ring]. The result is the extension of the kernel of the discrete first residue map along the constant-to-continuous scalar map [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data]. This is an equality of ordinary ringed-site ideals; no complex or completeness predicate occurs.

source.place: Section derived-completion-noetherian, opening paragraph; sites-modules lemma-completion-flat, quotient identifications

proof.text: The DVR maximal ideal is the radical of the ideal generated by l. Indeed l is a nonzero nonunit and the DVR maximal ideal is its only nonzero prime. Transfer this equality through ULift.ringEquiv.

Constant sheafification of a reduced ring has reduced section rings: locally lift a nilpotent section to the constant presheaf, locally detect its vanishing power by local injectivity, and use reducedness followed by separatedness. The first quotient is reduced since the uniformizer ideal is prime. flat_and_quotients says the completed kernel is the image ideal of this uniformizer ideal. One containment in radical(l) follows by mapping radicals; the reverse follows because l dies in a reduced quotient.

Use the scalar-compatible comparison to identify the extended discrete residue kernel with the comap of the first completed kernel. Its sections therefore equal radical(l). The given completedSectionIso, like every ring isomorphism, preserves the span of the natural-number scalar l and commutes with ideal radicals. Hence extending the completed first kernel gives exactly the extended discrete kernel. Use the local span characterization of ringed-site ideal extension.

proof_origin.place: Lemma completion-flat (093M), with the intrinsic radical(l) argument and the scalar-compatible comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem completedSectionIdeal (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    (ConstantCompletion.kernelIdeal
      ((Scheme.sfbModelRings X).map
        (limit.π (Scheme.adicLisseRingSystem X (IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E))
          (op 0)))).extension
        ((Scheme.sfbModelRings X).map (completedSectionIso l E X).hom) =
      (ConstantCompletion.kernelIdeal (smallMap X (residueMap l E X))).extension
        (smallMap X (scalarMap l E X))
